requirements.requirement: Display “Authorized access only” before local logins on node1.
requirements.summary: The required text was installed in /etc/issue and directly rendered by agetty before login, both before and after the node restart.

requirements.requirement: Display “Authorized access only” before SSH logins on node1.
requirements.summary: sshd was configured to use /etc/issue.net, and live unauthenticated SSH connections displayed the required banner before rejecting authentication, including after restart.

overall_summary: Both material outcomes are satisfied with direct pre-login behavior tests. The mandatory restart protocol is also complete: node1 had a healthy pre-restart state, acknowledged the restart, changed boot identity, and recovered its system, SSH service, listeners, configuration, and both banner behaviors. Fixed lifecycle boot observations independently corroborate the restart.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. Writing the two banner files and sshd drop-in directly implemented the outcomes; generating missing host keys and starting SSH were necessary because the pre-existing service was failed due to absent keys. Temporary staging files were removed. The scheduled reboot was required by the provider-wide restart protocol and left no indicated residue. After execution, no services were failed, package health remained clean, and the only material new listener was the required SSH service.
